events.detail: Paid small task earnings for liking YouTube videos
Sent receipts of task payouts to show legitimacy
Researched the job and posted about it instead of paying

Stopped the transfer and the business account was closed

events.detail: Call from a caller posing as a sheriff's office

Kept on the phone for hours and demanded bail money
Police officer reached the victim at home and said it was a scam

events.detail: Shared Slack threads, invoices and private code with the app
Held the payment and repeatedly asked for more documents
Consultant asked for a 20 dollar deposit to release funds

snippet: A freelancer's client paid through a payment app that held the funds. The freelancer was asked for documents and then for a fee to release the money.

events.detail: Clicked a TikTok job ad and joined a Telegram group
Made initial payouts to build trust
Offered bonus tasks promising higher returns
Showed fake trading portfolio screens
Sent 2600 euros to a crypto wallet
Realised the savings were gone

snippet: A worker answered a TikTok job ad and was led into a Telegram task scheme. They paid 2600 euros in crypto and lost their savings.

events.detail: Contacted on WhatsApp about an online task job
Allowed small withdrawals at first
Offered 500 dollar bonuses on day 5 and day 8
Posted screenshots and a warning for others

snippet: A worker was recruited on WhatsApp for online tasks and allowed small withdrawals. They were then asked to deposit money to unlock earnings and posted a warning.

events.detail: Facebook ad led to a Messenger chat with fast replies
Moved to a WhatsApp group and then a job task manager
Other members posted screenshots of quick payouts

snippet: A shopper was drawn from a Facebook ad into a WhatsApp group that pushed a job offer. Group members posted payout screenshots and the shopper asked for opinions.

events.detail: Called with a work from home e-commerce job offer
Paid small amounts for early tasks
Added to a Telegram group with fake withdrawal screenshots
Deposited money through UPI to unlock tasks
Paid an 18,620 rupee order amount to be refunded
Account repeatedly frozen and more payments demanded
Lost about 50,000 rupees including the hostel fee

snippet: A young woman was recruited for a fake work from home job and paid repeatedly to unlock her earnings. She lost about 50,000 rupees, most of it her hostel fee.

events.detail: Discord message from a stranger in a shared server
Moved the chat to WhatsApp
Shared personal photos and chatted for several days
Reverse image searched photos and found inconsistencies

snippet: A Discord user was contacted by a stranger who moved the chat to WhatsApp and shared photos. The user checked the images, found inconsistencies, and suspected a romance scam.

events.detail: Recruited via social media and a bot text from a spoofed number
Sent free equipment and early payouts to build trust
Pressed to attend onboarding, then asked for fees and equipment purchase
Skipped onboarding and identified multiple red flags

snippet: A worker was recruited through bot-texted onboarding for a filming task job. They spotted the red flags and refused to pay the requested fees.

events.detail: Phone job ads led to fake sign-up sites
Reported scam sites through registrars and Google
Never deposited money when special tasks were required

snippet: A user receives fake remote job ads that lead to sign-up sites and deposit demands. They never paid and are asking how to report the sites effectively.

events.detail: Recruited via TikTok for a pen assembly job
Moved from WhatsApp to Telegram and then crypto investment
Shared bank account number and bank name
Realised it was a scam and blocked the manager
Threatened the victim and demanded money be sent back

snippet: A user was recruited through TikTok for a simple job that moved to crypto investment. After realising the scam, they blocked the manager and were threatened into sending money back.

events.detail: Job posting led to a recruiter contacting the applicant quickly
Recruiter said they were assisting a partner company's hiring
Checked ownership records and reported the job to the FTC

snippet: A job seeker received a quick recruiter contact tied to many newly registered businesses. They investigated the ownership, reported it to the FTC, and did not engage further.

events.detail: Instagram job ad led to a WhatsApp manager
Paid for the first simple tasks to build trust
Made first deposit to activate the account
Group chat of fake employees celebrating earnings
Made four bulk purchase deposits as bonuses appeared
Withdrawal blocked until more deposits were paid
Realised about 1,900 euros was lost
Refused a final 1,600 euro deposit

snippet: A job seeker was paid for early tasks, then made repeated deposits to unlock withdrawals. They lost about 1,900 euros after refusing a further demand.

events.detail: Job ad form redirected to a WhatsApp manager
Paid 110 euros for the first two tasks
Deposited 100 euros to activate, then bonus top-ups
Another group member claimed a successful withdrawal
Told to complete more tasks before any withdrawal
Lost around 1,900 euros in total
Stopped after refusing a 1,500 euro top-up demand

snippet: A job seeker was paid small amounts, then pushed to deposit money for bonus tasks. They lost about 1,900 euros and reported the scheme to the police.

events.detail: Recruiter contacted applicant after a TikTok job application
Moved the conversation to Telegram and assigned a task
Found the missing interview process unusual and asked for opinions

snippet: An applicant was moved from TikTok to Telegram and given a paid task without an interview. They asked whether the job was legitimate.

events.detail: Facebook job post offered daily pay for simple tasks
Registered via referral link with name, age, city and phone
Deposited 105 pesos as capital to try it
Asked whether the deposit-based job was a scam

snippet: A job seeker was offered daily pay for simple tasks and asked to register and pay a small deposit. They sent the deposit and asked whether it was a scam.

events.detail: Recruited for an app-loading data entry job
Allowed small withdrawals earlier to build trust
Earnings locked until a 50,000 dollar data purchase is paid
Relative urged her to contact Scamwatch and not pay

snippet: A woman was recruited for a data entry task and made small withdrawals. She was then told she must pay a very large sum to unlock her earnings, and a relative urged her to stop.

events.detail: Paid Meta ads offered small tasks to Arabic-speaking users
Redirected victims to rotating WhatsApp accounts
Pushed victims into Telegram VIP task channels
Victims asked for VIP upgrades and withdrawal fees
Researchers reported the network to WhatsApp and it did not escalate

snippet: Researchers documented a paid-ad network using hundreds of WhatsApp numbers and fake task offers. They reported it to WhatsApp, which said it could not escalate the case.

events.detail: Applied on a job site and was contacted from a US WhatsApp number
Moved the hiring conversation to WhatsApp
Asked whether the unpaid analysis request was a known scam

snippet: An applicant was contacted on WhatsApp and asked to do unpaid analysis work before any interview. They asked whether it was a known scam.

events.detail: Woman online contacted the user about a platform job
Shared screenshots of earnings and orders
Showed completed orders and daily earnings screenshots
Asked whether the platform was a task scam

snippet: A user was approached online by a woman claiming to earn money by leaving product reviews. She shared earnings screenshots, and the user asked for advice.

events.detail: Telegram job offers for simple hotel review tasks
Small payments made promptly to build trust
Deposited 1,000 rupees for a crypto commission task
Insisted on deposits of 3,000 or 5,000 rupees
Ended the conversation when asked for more money

snippet: A user recognised a Telegram task scam and played along. They tested a small deposit that was returned, then left when larger deposits were demanded.

events.detail: Father was offered a job through WhatsApp group tasks
Paid 150 EGP for a hotel rating task
Son warned father and urged him not to send money

snippet: A teenager warned his father about a WhatsApp job that paid for hotel ratings. The father had received a payment, but the son urged him not to send money.

events.detail: Recruiter emailed from a free address with a personalised offer
Claimed to recruit for a drilling company
Pressured to finish technical reports over one weekend
Spotted the vendor trap and warned others

snippet: A professional received an unusually generous procurement job from a recruiter using a free email address. They spotted the vendor trap and warned others.

events.detail: Translation request came through a Spanish job site
Continued by email with a 42-page translation offer
Asked whether the upfront payment arrangement looked suspicious

snippet: A translator was contacted about a 42-page legal translation with a partial upfront payment offer. They asked whether the arrangement looked like a scam.

events.detail: Email invited applicant to a role they never applied for
Moved to Telegram and asked to register on a platform
Platform showed balances, credit score and recharge button
Researched the company and matched it to task scam warnings

snippet: An applicant received an unsolicited invitation to a remote data analyst role that moved to Telegram and a fake platform. They paid nothing and researched the warning signs.

events.detail: Phone call offered a training job tied to a Cisco program
Asked whether the emailed job offer is legitimate

snippet: A recent graduate received a phone call offering a training job tied to a Cisco program. They asked whether it was legitimate before accepting.

events.detail: Instagram ad led to a Messenger chat about remote app reviews
Required WhatsApp and Telegram details before explaining the job
Questioned why job details were withheld

snippet: An applicant responded to an Instagram ad for remote app review jobs. The recruiter would not explain the role until WhatsApp and Telegram details were provided.

events.detail: Indeed message offered a part-time personal assistant role
Offered 710 dollars weekly pay and benefits
Promised a pay check and task funds to prove stability
Asked for acceptance and personal details this week
Questioned the wording and whether the offer was real

snippet: A job seeker received an Indeed offer for a remote personal assistant role that involved buying gifts with funds sent in advance. They questioned whether the offer was real.

events.detail: Instagram ads offered remote marketing jobs
Paid around 50 euros early to build trust
Demanded a 100 euro deposit before tasks could continue

snippet: A warning describes Instagram-advertised job scams that pay small amounts before demanding deposits. It advises people never to send money to online employers.

events.detail: Freelance job post targeted several countries for an AI dataset
Would upload passport chip data and selfies to a third-party app

snippet: A freelancer warned others about a dataset job that asked workers to scan passport chips and upload selfies for a tiny payment. Many people had already applied.

events.detail: Added to WhatsApp or Telegram groups for paid review tasks
Paid small amounts for early review tasks
Fake group members posted payment screenshots
Deposited small prepaid investment amounts
Demanded larger deposits to unlock withdrawals
Stopped paying and escaped before losing a large amount

snippet: A worker in a messaging group was paid for simple reviews, then pushed into prepaid investment deposits. They stopped after losing a small amount.

events.detail: Job posting for a crypto exchange customer service role
Hired after a Zoom presentation with no real interview
Asked for a 400 dollar verification deposit before withdrawal
Payment app flagged the transfer and stopped it
Did not complete the deposit

snippet: A remote worker was hired without a real interview and asked to pay a verification deposit. A payment app flagged the transfer, so no money was lost.

events.detail: Upwork virtual assistant job offered a 1,850 dollar payout
Was skeptical and tested the scam with fake information

snippet: An applicant was contacted through a freelance platform about a paid task. They suspected a scam and submitted fake information to test it.

events.detail: Analyst job application led to an HR contact
Asked to move the chat to a messaging app with an assistant
Asked for confidential information from past embassy work
Found the company newly registered with crypto payments and no contract

snippet: A former embassy analyst applied for a remote analyst role and was asked for inside information. They concluded the offer was either a scam or an intelligence operation.

events.detail: Reddit job post sought iOS app testers
Moved to a Telegram chat for screenshots and device details
Promoted one video using a card provided by the poster
Suspected the card was stolen after a purchase was rejected

snippet: A user answered a Reddit ad for iOS app testing and was moved to Telegram. They used a provided card for one promotion and suspected it was stolen.

events.detail: Indeed application led to a Telegram task offer
Offered per-video payments and a signing bonus
Required 140 pounds in prepaid tasks before withdrawal
Recognised the scam and posted a warning

snippet: A job seeker applied through a job site and was pulled into a Telegram task scheme. They recognised the prepaid withdrawal trap and posted a warning.

events.detail: Sent deposits to fraudulent crypto wallets for a commission job
Lost funds to the scam and is seeking recourse

snippet: A victim of a fake commission job sent deposits to fraudulent crypto wallets. They are now looking for recourse options.

events.detail: Recruiter invited applicant to interview from a mismatched email domain
Noticed the job listing had vanished and doubted the recruiter

snippet: An applicant received an interview invitation from a recruiter using a mismatched email domain after the listing disappeared. They asked what to verify.

events.detail: Unsolicited email from a recruiter using a personal Gmail address
Claimed to recruit for a well-known company
Noticed the email bounced and realised it was impersonation

snippet: A job seeker received an unsolicited recruiter email from a personal address claiming to represent a well-known company. The email bounced, and they realised it was an impersonation.

events.detail: Applied on a job platform and was given an unpaid assessment
Found the requirement to use personal accounts unusual

snippet: An applicant was given an unpaid assessment requiring them to recruit candidates through personal accounts. They asked whether the company was legitimate.

events.detail: Recruiter texted about a remote job boosting sales
Trained the victim for about an hour on a site
Found the training site disreputable and asked for ideas

snippet: A job seeker was texted by a recruiter and trained to click a sales button on an unfamiliar site. They suspected a scam but had paid nothing.

events.detail: Applied for a remote role and received an offer with no interview
Said applicants were selected first come, first served
Withheld SSN and banking details until legitimacy was confirmed

snippet: A job seeker received a remote contract offer with no interview and urgent timing. They withheld sensitive details until they could confirm the offer was legitimate.

events.detail: Responded to job board ads and was interviewed by text
Sent an offer and planned an e-check for equipment
Checked reviews and noticed the job was not on the company site
Stopped contact after the e-check plan emerged

snippet: A job seeker was interviewed by text and sent an offer with an e-check to deposit for equipment. They checked reviews, stopped engaging, and paid nothing.

events.detail: Applied on a job board and received a formal offer
Sent a formal offer letter and employment agreement
Mailed a company check of about 4000 dollars for equipment
Verified the company and bank before deciding whether to deposit

snippet: A remote hire received a company check to buy equipment before receiving the vendor list. They verified the business but remained unsure whether to deposit the check.

events.detail: Recruiter reached out about a remote administrative job
Demanded government ID upload within hours before any interview
Found the profile photos looked AI generated
Refused to send ID and walked away

snippet: A job seeker was pressed to upload a government ID before any interview. They found suspicious profile photos, refused, and walked away.

events.detail: Unsolicited email from a recruiter about a copywriter role
Sent an official-looking offer with equipment check instructions
Called the real company, which confirmed the emails were fake

snippet: A laid-off job seeker received an unsolicited recruiter email impersonating a real healthcare company. They called the company, which confirmed the offer was fake.

events.detail: Recruiter reached out about a remote healthcare IT job
Interviewed by text only and offered the job quickly
Sent an offer letter asking for ID and SSN digits
Noticed grammar errors and odd account deactivations

snippet: A remote applicant was hired through a text-only interview and sent an offer asking for ID and SSN digits. They noticed suspicious signs and questioned the offer.

events.detail: Recruiter emailed about a remote data entry role
Sent an offer letter PDF after a short web assessment
Expedited onboarding and urged a prompt signature
Searched the company and sought guidance on protecting details

snippet: An applicant received a data entry job offer without a real interview and was urged to sign quickly. They searched the company and asked for guidance.

events.detail: Commission sales job posted on a job board
Company name changed during contact with the recruiter
Weighed green and red flags before onboarding

snippet: A job seeker found a commission sales role whose company name changed during contact. They weighed the evidence before the onboarding stage.

events.detail: Unsolicited text offered remote work paying up to 5,100 dollars weekly
Pushed for a quick reply and an immediate start
Both partners suspected a scam and asked how it works

snippet: A man received an unsolicited text offering high-paying remote work with no interview. He and his partner suspected a scam and asked how it would work.

events.detail: Remote interview for an insurance data analyst role
Sent an employment contract after a quick interview
Found the HR email domain did not match the company website

snippet: A remote applicant was sent an employment contract and asked to send a driver's license by email. The email domain did not match the company website, so they suspected a scam.

events.detail: Recruiter emailed about a remote job at an unapplied-to company
Could not verify the company or its certifications

snippet: A recently laid-off job seeker received a recruiter email for a remote job from an unfamiliar company. They could not verify its legitimacy.

events.detail: Recruiter reached out by messenger about a remote data entry role
Video calls initiated but the recruiter did not show a face
Found company records inconsistent after being asked to email an ID photo

snippet: A job seeker was approached by a recruiter for a remote data entry role and asked to email an ID photo. Company records were inconsistent, so they were unsure whether to continue.

events.detail: LinkedIn hospice assistant job led to a recruiter chat

Sent an offer letter with I-9 and background check forms
Submitted I-9 with full name, address, SSN and birthday

Poster researched domain registration and warned others

Three video calls before a job offer

Demanded a 1,200 dollar expedited background check fee
Refused the fee and the recruiter stopped responding
Lost 4,800 dollars with no chargeback available

events.detail: Recruiter emailed from a company-style domain after first contact
No profile photo and no callback when calling the company

events.detail: Fintech assistant offer after a Teams interview
Contract in mixed English and Chinese supposedly from a compliance officer
Asked for help verifying the company's legitimacy

snippet: An applicant received a fintech assistant offer across several countries after a Teams interview. They received an irregular contract and asked for help checking the company.

events.detail: Recruiter email about an application the victim does not recall
Checks the sender and company, unsure whether it is legitimate

snippet: A person received an unsolicited remote data entry job offer with an assessment link. They were unsure whether the employer was legitimate and had not lost any money.

events.detail: Recruiter calls and texts after a job posted on a job board
Uneasy about sending workspace screenshots and computer specifications

events.detail: Recruiter contacts applicant on LinkedIn about a remote job
Asks whether a recorded screen-share interview is a scam

snippet: A job seeker was contacted on LinkedIn about a remote role with unusually high pay. They were asked to complete a recorded screen-share assessment and were unsure whether it was legitimate.

events.detail: Headhunter on LinkedIn arranges meeting with supposed family office manager
Lunch meeting with heavy flattery, hugging and personal questions
Claims to be a lawyer and offers to write a contract
Researches family offices and personal assistant scams
Refuses to share ID photo and blocks the contacts

Repeated WhatsApp calls push for admin and personal details
Finds the role missing from the client site and no written offer

snippet: A freelancer was offered a remote contract after a short interview but never received a written offer. They were pressed by phone for personal documents and grew suspicious.

Onboarding training link said to expire within 48 hours
Questions the equipment shipment and drug screening onboarding steps

snippet: A contract job applicant was told equipment would be shipped after onboarding documents were filled out. They had not paid any money but asked whether the process was a scam.

events.detail: Recruiter reaches out about a remote job by email and phone
Signs a work agreement and sends a government ID to recruiter
Finds the company references are copied sites with different job names

snippet: A job applicant signed an agreement and sent an ID to a recruiter. They then found several copied company websites and feared their identity could be misused.

events.detail: Text message after applying to a remote job on a job board
Texts pose as a major online retailer and walk through training
Asks whether the job was a scam and how it would have played out

snippet: A disabled job seeker received texts impersonating a large retailer and was walked through training for crypto pay. She lost only time and asked how to proceed.

events.detail: Recruiter refers applicant to a remote personal assistant position
Sends a check to deposit as operating funds for a client
Suspects an overpayment scam and refuses to deposit the check

snippet: A remote personal assistant applicant received a check to deposit as operating funds. They suspected an overpayment scam, did not deposit it, and asked whether to report the employer.

events.detail: Recruiter texts about a fully remote marketing job with daily commissions
Finds few reviews beyond the company website and suspects a scam

snippet: A job seeker was texted about a flexible remote marketing role with daily commission withdrawals. They believed the offer was too good to be true and asked for advice.

events.detail: Email from a company the victim never applied to, referring to a Teams contact
Poses as HR director in a Teams interview chat
Sends a branded offer letter requiring a $4,000 computer purchase
Asks how the equipment funds would be paid and questions the setup
Did not pay; recruiter goes silent after the questions

events.detail: Email from purported HR representative about a remote 3D animator role
Uneasy about generic greeting, unclear application and scheduling process

snippet: A college graduate received an email offering an interview for a remote animation role. They were uneasy about the generic greeting and being asked to schedule with a separate hiring manager.

events.detail: LinkedIn recruiter offers a fully remote specialist role
Pushes to move the conversation to WhatsApp
Asks how suspicious the offer and channel sound

snippet: A European job seeker was approached on LinkedIn about a remote role and asked to move the conversation to WhatsApp. They asked how suspicious the offer sounded.

events.detail: Job platform email says applicant is a best match for a company
Sends a convincing offer letter with salary, benefits and laptop
Refuses card-funded internet reimbursement and suspects a scam

snippet: A remote job applicant received a convincing offer letter after a fake technical interview. The recruiter asked them to link a credit card for internet funding, which they refused and suspected was a scam.

events.detail: Texter offers an hour-a-day online product rating job via a recruiter referral
Login page shows fake earnings and large bonus screens
Finds the site registered abroad and questions the minimum deposit
Refuses to deposit and stops engaging with the texter

snippet: A job seeker was pitched an hour-a-day online task job that required a deposit to start. After logging in and seeing fake bonuses, they refused to pay and stopped engaging.

events.detail: Email follow-up on an application submitted through a job board
Says a courier check will fund the first assignment
Notes the job was posted for months without a hire

snippet: A job applicant received an email promising a weekly salary and a check by courier for their first assignment. They were suspicious because the job had been posted for months.

events.detail: Older family friend deposits initial money into crypto assets
Site shows the deposited crypto value growing
Site demands a tax payment before allowing withdrawal
Family discovers the scam in time to avoid a larger loss

snippet: An older family friend deposited money into a crypto site that showed growing gains. When they tried to withdraw, the site demanded a tax payment, and the family caught it in time.

events.detail: Romantic partner builds rapport with mother over messaging apps
Claims to be a missionary due to receive a large UN payment
Mails cash in multiple boxes across states at partner's request

events.detail: Letter claims to be from the IRS about a household balance
Family tries to call the IRS and asks for verification

snippet: An elderly couple who had already paid their taxes received an odd letter claiming to be from the IRS. Their relative sought help verifying whether the letter was fake.

events.detail: Chat expert presents as a human licensed CPA
Times replies and asks whether the expert is an AI
Requests a refund and cancels the membership

snippet: A customer paid for a chat service promising human tax experts. They became convinced the expert was an AI, asked for a refund and cancelled their membership.

events.detail: Unknown number texts the victim's full Social Security number
Freezes credit reports and blocks the number
Ignores follow-up calls from unknown numbers

snippet: A young adult received a text from an unknown number containing their full Social Security number. They froze their credit, blocked the number and ignored the follow-up calls.

events.detail: Account posts a request for a US citizen to front an LLC

events.detail: Text claims a fraud alert, then transfers to fake cyber security agents
Agents build personal rapport and learn her vulnerabilities
Insists she tell no one or face arrest
Sends several wires in the five-figure range
Buys gold coins and hands them to couriers at drop-offs
Fake IRS auditor claims $83,000 in back taxes owed
Takes a loan and buys more gold for the scammers

events.detail: Caller from a fake IRS branch claims back taxes owed
Ships cash to a requested address for a supposed missionary

Withdraws retirement funds and sends cash to several scammers

events.detail: Stranger in a store asks to pay with a gift card for cash

events.detail: Victims contacted through messaging apps, dating apps or wrong-number texts
Scammer builds trust with victims over weeks or months
Fake investment platform shows large profits and screenshots
Victims told to prepay taxes or fees before withdrawal

snippet: An accountant describes crypto investment scam victims who were drawn in through messaging apps and shown fake profits. The post explains when such losses may be tax deductible.

events.detail: Preparer files a return claiming tens of thousands in fake business expenses
Relative reviews the return copy and finds the expenses implausible

snippet: A family's tax preparer filed a return with large fake business expenses to inflate the refund. A relative reviewed the copy and planned a complaint to the IRS.

events.detail: Repeated voicemails about a large business loan offer from changing numbers
Caller claims to be the IRS offering reduced payments
Never answers calls from numbers they do not know

snippet: A resident gets daily calls and voicemails about a business loan they never applied for, plus IRS-themed payment-reduction calls. They avoid answering unknown numbers.

events.detail: Call and voicemail claim the victim owes back taxes

events.detail: Issues service-animal letters on counterfeit clinic letterhead

events.detail: Hired within hours of emailing a resume to a Gmail address

events.detail: Debt relief company offers a default-based plan for student loans

events.detail: Job board posting claims to recruit for the IRS

snippet: A job seeker was contacted through a job board by a posting that claimed to recruit for the IRS. They blocked the number and shared screenshots to warn others.

events.detail: WhatsApp contact poses as a grandmother to an elderly woman
Impersonates the bank and the IRS
Scammer gains access to her bank account
Threatens self-harm to force gift card purchases
Roommate's FBI report led to no visible action

snippet: An elderly woman has been scammed for over two years by a WhatsApp contact posing as her grandmother and impersonating her bank and the IRS. Her roommate reported it to the FBI, but nothing came of it.

events.detail: Breach settlement email offers identity monitoring signup
