Login fails and the login page branding looks altered

snippet: A data breach notice led to a monitoring signup email that asked for an SSN. The signup site looked wrong and the victim suspected phishing.

events.detail: Letter from purported IRS says a refund is owed
Checks the account and plans to call the IRS

snippet: A person received a letter claiming to be from the IRS about a refund owed from 2020. They checked their account and planned to call to verify it.

events.detail: Met on a dating app and shared personal details
Claims to be an IRS officer with an MBBS degree
Shares degree, ID and passport images over video call
Finds the rank claim inconsistent and communication secretive

snippet: A woman met a man on a dating app who claimed to be an IRS officer and shared identity documents. She became suspicious after finding inconsistencies in his claims and secretive communication.

events.detail: Bank letter demands an IRS form with SSN or higher withholding
Notices no stamped envelope and calls the bank's fraud team
Disregards the letter after the bank says it is not genuine

snippet: A bank customer received a letter demanding an IRS form with their Social Security number. They called the bank's fraud team, which said the letter was not genuine.

events.detail: WhatsApp contact says he is moving to the victim's area
Chats for a year and pitches crypto-linked investments
Pressures the victim to open an IRS account immediately
Asks what the purpose of the IRS account is

snippet: A person chatted with a WhatsApp contact for a year, who pitched crypto investments and then pressed them to open an IRS account immediately. They asked what the purpose was.

events.detail: Facebook contact poses as a military sergeant
Builds a bond over WhatsApp with a shared backstory
Sends a fake IRS document to prove legitimacy
Demands a $5,500 fee to release a delayed courier package
Son reports the scam to police but the mother ignores it

snippet: A mother's romance with a supposed military sergeant led her to set up a business and bank account to receive funds. Her son found a fake courier receipt and photos on a scam-watch page, but she still believes the sergeant is real.

events.detail: Offers pay to rent out a freelancing account
Sends a polished contractor agreement to seem safe

snippet: A warning describes job offers that pay people to rent out their freelancing accounts, which are used to launder stolen funds. It explains the bans, liability and steps to take.

events.detail: Recorded voicemail from a tax relief group calls from changing numbers
Says collections continue unless the victim responds promptly
Asks how to stop repeated calls after opting out

snippet: A taxpayer who already filed keeps receiving robocalls from changing numbers offering to settle tax debt for pennies. They asked how to stop the calls.

events.detail: Attorneys general send a notice citing thousands of traceback alerts

snippet: A research report argues a telecom subsidiary enabled a large share of imposter robocalls, citing regulator notices. The report names the company's US units as the main enablers.

events.detail: Text offers part-time online job earning up to $6,000 monthly
Work account shows a growing balance and commission earnings
Funds negative account balances to keep completing tasks
Demands large withdrawal fees and fake IRS and guarantee letters
Secret Service traces transfers abroad but cannot recover funds

snippet: A victim was lured by a text offering online product-rating work and shown a large fake balance. They say about $350,000 of their own and others' money went into fees, and authorities could not recover the transfers.

events.detail: YouTube ads show a fake charity appeal for an at-risk person

snippet: A viewer found ads asking for donations for a supposedly vulnerable individual, with the funds going to an unrelated religious organization. The viewer believes the cases are fabricated.

events.detail: Tax office calls saying the victim dropped off extra income paperwork
Forged 1099 form submitted to add $72,500 of income
Calls the insurer, finds no record and stops the filing

snippet: A taxpayer was called by a tax office claiming they had dropped off a forged 1099 for large extra income. They checked with the insurer, found no record and stopped the filing.

events.detail: Voicemail claims account was flagged and asks for a callback
Blocks the number and marks the message as spam

snippet: A person received a voicemail claiming their tax file needed review and asked for a callback. They blocked the number and marked the message as spam.

events.detail: Homeowners pay upfront and then see no progress on work
Federal court convicts contractor over fake tax records scheme

snippet: A warning describes a remodeling contractor with unresolved complaints from customers who paid for unfinished work. Federal court records also describe a fraud case involving fake tax records.

events.detail: Sends extensive business and personal documents to the accountant
Notes repeated missed calls and cancelled video meetings

snippet: A foreign business owner sent sensitive personal and business information to a CPA they found through a government list. They grew suspicious after repeated missed calls and cancelled meetings.

events.detail: Dishonest preparer reports a phantom business loss for a large refund

snippet: An accountant warns that dishonest tax preparers can add phantom business losses to inflate refunds. Taxpayers remain liable for back taxes even if they were unaware.

events.detail: Robocall impersonating the IRS answered by mistake
Hangs up and blocks the number

snippet: A person gets frequent scam calls, and one IRS-themed call reached them. They hung up, blocked the number and asked how to stop the calls.

events.detail: Voicemail claims an account review needs a callback
Doubts the call because the IRS usually writes by mail

snippet: A person who had already filed received a voicemail claiming their account was under review and asking for a callback. They doubted it because the IRS usually contacts people by mail.

events.detail: Repeated voicemails claim a tax matter is headed to collections
Reports spam and deletes each voicemail

snippet: A person has received the same IRS-themed voicemail for over a month from different numbers. They report and delete each one and asked whether there is a way to stop them.

events.detail: Robo voicemails claim a special IRS tax resolution unit
Calls back the numbers and asks for the caller's name

snippet: A person receives many voicemails claiming to be from an IRS tax resolution unit. They started calling back, asking for names, and wanted to warn others.

events.detail: Spoofed IRS-style email asks to review a reconciliation document
Does not open the download after browser flags a virus

snippet: A taxpayer received a spoofed email asking them to review a reconciliation document after their refund was approved. They did not open the file and confirmed the IRS does not request this by email.

events.detail: Stranger sends a Zelle payment with no explanation
Asks whether the transfers could be used to access the account

snippet: A friend received a Zelle payment from a stranger, then a larger one a month later with no contact. The friend asks whether these transfers could be a scam to gain account access.

events.detail: Real estate firm job offer with unusually high entry-level pay
Sends a $4,300 check to buy specialised equipment
Sends $500 by Zelle toward the equipment
Realises the check failed and contacts the bank

snippet: A job applicant was sent a $4,300 check to buy equipment for a fake real estate job. They sent $500 by Zelle, then the check failed and the applicant contacted their bank.

events.detail: Caller claims to be a bank about suspicious Zelle transfers
Transfers caller to a fake returns department
Hangs up and calls the bank's official number

snippet: A bank customer received a call about two suspicious Zelle transfers and was passed to a fake returns department. They hung up, called the number on their card and confirmed it was a scam.

events.detail: Crypto P2P buyer pays through several third-party Zelle transfers
Callers demand the seller return the money
Suspects a triangulation scam after releasing the crypto

snippet: A crypto seller received several Zelle payments from different people for one sale and was later asked to refund them. The seller suspects a triangulation scam and asks how banks handled similar cases.

events.detail: Client requests a logo design and offers payment only by check
Suspects an overpayment and refund check scam

snippet: A freelance logo designer was contacted through a website form for a project paid only by check. The designer was suspicious of the check-only request and asked whether it was an overpayment scam.

events.detail: Fake salvage yard contacted buyer on WhatsApp after a search
Buyer paid for a wheel via Zelle and never received it
Fake courier demanded a refundable $120 insurance fee
Buyer recognised the insurance demand as the final sign of fraud
Buyer refused to pay the courier fee
Buyer realised the wheel payment was gone

snippet: A buyer paid a fake salvage yard for a wheel and never received it. The fake courier then demanded an insurance fee, which the buyer refused to pay.

events.detail: Stranger sent $500 via Zelle and said it was a mistake
Bank fraud agent advised the recipient to send the money back personally
Recipient recognised a payment reversal scam pattern
Recipient refused to send the money back

snippet: A person received an unexpected $500 transfer and was told by a bank agent to send it back. They refused, recognising a common payment reversal scam.

events.detail: Broker quoted a reasonable price using a legitimate company's reputation
Customer paid the initial moving quote by credit card
Movers claimed extra cubic feet and demanded more money
Customer paid an extra $2,000 via Zelle under pressure
Belongings held in storage until an outstanding balance was paid
Customer found the company unreachable and delivery dates shifting

snippet: A family hired a moving broker and was pressured into paying an extra $2,000. Their belongings were then held in storage until a further balance was demanded.

events.detail: Call showed a major bank name on the caller ID
Caller posed as bank fraud department about Zelle payments
Caller demanded quick action to stop payments before they went through
Recipient checked the apps and saw no such transactions
Recipient hung up and planned to call the bank directly

snippet: A caller posing as a bank fraud team claimed two Zelle payments needed urgent cancellation. The recipient found no such transactions and hung up.

events.detail: Facebook seller said item was dropped with a courier quickly
Buyer paid $110 via Zelle for a motorcycle part
Fake logistics firm demanded $170 international transit insurance
Buyer questioned an insurance fee for a domestic shipment

snippet: A buyer paid a Facebook seller for a motorcycle part and was then asked for an insurance fee by a logistics firm. The buyer suspected both were part of a scam.

events.detail: Caller claimed to be from a bank about a $900 charge
Caller transferred target to a fake Zelle fraud department
Representative insisted disputes be filed immediately or charges are final
Target realised the caller was not from the bank
Target refused to share balance details and hung up

snippet: A caller posing as a bank asked about fraudulent charges and transferred the target to a fake Zelle team. The target refused to share balance details and hung up.

events.detail: Call claimed to be from a bank the target does not use
Caller transferred target to a fake Zelle representative
Target reported the call to their real bank as a scam
Target ended the call without taking any action

snippet: A caller posing as a bank transferred the target to a fake Zelle representative who claimed to cancel transfers. The target reported it to their real bank and lost nothing.

events.detail: Buyer asked to ship an item out of state and paid $220
Buyer asked to text the seller and use a different address
Seller doubts the buyer's requests and suspects a scam

snippet: A seller received an out-of-state buyer who asked for a changed shipping address and to communicate by text. The seller began to suspect the sale was a scam.

events.detail: Buyer offered to pay in advance for a $175 desk
Fake Zelle support contact demanded a $500 minimum transfer
Seller noticed red flags and reported the buyer as a scam
Seller stopped engaging and sent no money

snippet: A seller was approached by a buyer who offered to pay in advance and then sent a fake Zelle support contact. The seller reported the buyer and sent no money.

events.detail: Realtor approved an application and sent a lease and receipt
Realtor claimed to represent a registered rental company
Payment requests moved to different payees and then to CashApp
Applicant noticed payee names differed from the landlord
Applicant did not send money and planned to question the realtor

snippet: An applicant was asked to pay rent and deposit into several differently named accounts and then through CashApp. The applicant stopped before sending any money.

events.detail: Rogue transfers left her account for unknown recipients
Bank and payment apps each said responsibility lay elsewhere

snippet: A person's relative saw money leave her account through transfers she did not make. Her bank and payment apps each said the responsibility lay with someone else.

events.detail: Caller claimed to be from a bank about a suspicious transaction
Caller verified identity while relaying answers to the real bank
Victim gave card number, SSN and date of birth
Victim read back one-time verification codes to the caller
Victim realised the call was wrong and phoned family
Family and bank fraud team froze accounts and confirmed no loss

snippet: A caller posing as a bank obtained personal details and verification codes from an older victim while relaying them to the real bank. Family and the bank fraud team froze the accounts and confirmed no money had left.

events.detail: Buyer offered $50 for a $35 item and offered to cover shipping
Buyer repeatedly pushed to reserve and pay before shipping
Seller found the overpayment and shipping offer suspicious

snippet: A seller received an offer above the asking price with shipping covered, and the buyer pressed for payment before shipping. The seller grew suspicious and asked how to stay safe.

events.detail: Parent emailed a tutor about sessions for a child abroad
Conversation moved from email to text messages
Tutor noticed unclear English and odd payment instructions
Tutor did not proceed with the mobile check arrangement

snippet: A tutor was contacted by a parent offering to pay by emailed mobile check. The tutor noticed the red flags and did not proceed.

events.detail: Buyer comments on a listing and leaves a phone number
Buyer moves to phone contact and says a relative will collect
Fake screenshots claim an overpayment sent as a business transaction
Scammers become aggressive when the seller does not comply

snippet: A seller describes buyers who comment on listings, move the conversation to a phone number, and send fake screenshots of an overpayment. They become aggressive when the seller does not comply.

events.detail: Friend asked the victim to receive a buyer's payment for a clothing sale
Victim forwarded $700 received from the buyer via Cash App
Bank put the account on hold and opened no fraud case
Victim learned the buyer had been scammed and contacted the bank

snippet: A person agreed to receive and forward a $700 payment for a friend's clothing sale, and later learned the buyer had been scammed. The bank then placed the person's account on hold.

events.detail: Landlord gave a relative's payment app for a $500 deposit
Payment app blocked the transfer and warned it was likely a scam
Renter asked for buyer-protected payment and was refused

snippet: A renter was asked to pay a $500 deposit through a relative's payment app, which the app blocked as a likely scam. The landlord refused a protected payment method.

events.detail: Unknown number sent $2,500 via Zelle and texted it was a mistake
Texts demanded the money be returned immediately
Bank advised leaving the money in place for reversal
Parent suspected fraud and blocked the number

snippet: A teenager received a $2,500 Zelle transfer from an unknown number, followed by texts demanding its return. The parent blocked the number and the money was left in the account.

events.detail: Facebook precious metals business had months of activity and reviews
Buyer paid via Zelle for a precious metals purchase
Business account was deleted with no communication after four days

snippet: A buyer paid a Facebook precious metals business through Zelle and then heard nothing. The business account was deleted, and the buyer filed disputes and an IC3 complaint.

events.detail: Artist contacted victim on a music platform offering a split
Scammer's social media accounts looked legitimate to the victim
Sent checks as payment for the painting project
Pressured victim to pay a paint supplier quickly
Victim paid about $1,000 via Zelle and Apple Pay
Bank froze the account and the payments were gone

snippet: A person recruited as an artist received checks and was pressured into paying a supplier about $1,000 through Zelle and Apple Pay. The bank then froze the account and the money was lost.

events.detail: Call came from a real bank phone number about new Zelle payments
Caller claimed to be bank fraud prevention needing Zelle cancellation
Caller said action had to happen immediately or funds could not be stopped
Victim questioned the free email address used for the reference
Victim hung up and phoned the bank directly

snippet: A caller posing as bank fraud prevention told the target to set up a Zelle cancellation. The target hung up and confirmed with the bank that no such call was made.

events.detail: Seller advertised concert tickets on TikTok with a phone number
Buyer sent the ticket payment via Cash App
Seller sent screen recording and tickets that appeared in Apple Wallet
Fake ticketing company emails said tickets would be cancelled unless fees paid
Buyer paid a $70 resale fee to keep the tickets
Seller demanded an additional $85 charge to return the tickets
Buyer asked for a refund and realised it was a scam
Refund never arrived because the seller's payment app blocked it

snippet: A buyer paid for concert tickets from a TikTok seller, then paid a fake resale fee after receiving realistic tickets and emails. The seller then demanded more money and blocked the buyer's refund.

events.detail: Google Maps listing directed victim to a Telegram booking
Booking conversation moved from the website to Telegram
Victim paid a deposit to a Chime account
Sent a fake appointment confirmation screenshot
Victim found the address was an alley next to a hotel
Telegram messages were edited to raise the required deposit
Victim sent further deposits after claimed double booking
Victim stopped after a $300 safety deposit was demanded

snippet: A person booked a massage through a fake Google Maps listing and paid several deposits to different Chime accounts. The amounts were edited upward in messages until the victim stopped.

events.detail: Buyer claimed to have paid, but payment showed as on hold
Fake Venmo support number sent via screenshot as a trusted contact
Victim shared screen on a FaceTime call with the caller
Victim realised the money was gone and the bank would not refund it

snippet: A marketplace seller was told a buyer's payment was on hold and was directed to a fake support line. The seller shared a screen with the scammer and lost money that the bank would not recover.

events.detail: Social media ad offered a free modeling audition for a child
Family paid a $50 refundable booking deposit
Salesperson pressured family to buy a $2,500 package on the spot
Family signed for and was charged a $2,500 portfolio package
Family felt uneasy and sent a cancellation email within two hours
Credit card issuer placed the charge on monitoring and advised a dispute

snippet: A family responded to a social media audition ad and was pressured into signing for a $2,500 modeling package. They cancelled quickly and disputed the charge with their card issuer.

events.detail: Call spoofed a bank number with poor audio quality
Caller claimed fraudulent charges and walked through a Zelle transfer
Victim recognised the transfer to self as obviously a scam
Victim hung up and ignored repeated calls
Bank changed passwords and cards after the victim reported it

snippet: A caller posing as a bank tried to walk the target through sending their savings to a Zelle account. The target hung up, and the bank reset the account credentials and cards.

events.detail: Investment Discord linked from a trading forum was used as a lure
Live stock calls and vouching members built credibility in the group
Victim was directed to a fake copy-trading platform
Victim deposited $3,000 via PayPal to the platform
Victim deposited $2,500 via Venmo and $500 via Zelle
Host aggressively pressured the victim to deposit more
Victim realised the platform was fake and members were bots
PayPal and Venmo refunded, but the bank denied the $500 Zelle refund

snippet: A person was lured into a fake copy-trading platform through a Discord group and deposited $6,000. Payment providers refunded most of it, but the $500 Zelle deposit was not recovered.

events.detail: Buyer asked for Zelle or Venmo details before viewing the TV
Buyer followed up by email with a link to a website
Victim entered debit card details on the fake receiving site
Victim uploaded an ID and face photos for verification
Victim's account was drained, leaving only $1

snippet: A seller of a TV was tricked into sharing debit card details, ID and face photos through a fake website. The seller's account was drained by about $1,000.

events.detail: Fake rental listing booked a tour that gave a temporary door code
Scammer had the victim sign a fake rental contract
Victim paid $2,600 through a payment app to the fake landlord
Victim could not recover the payment after realising the scam

snippet: A renter was shown a rental property through a temporary access code and signed a fake contract. The renter paid $2,600 through a payment app and could not get it back.

events.detail: Buyer reacted quickly to a listing and asked general questions
Buyer gave a number to message off Facebook
Buyer asked to pay first via Zelle or a cash app
Seller refused to sign up for a payment app and sent no money

snippet: A Facebook Marketplace seller was approached by a buyer who wanted to move off-platform and pay first through Zelle or a cash app. The seller refused and lost nothing.

events.detail: Victim joined a Discord trading server run by a self-described options trader
Host had made good calls that day, building credibility
Victim sent $2,700 in USDC on promise of a Zelle return
Host kept asking for more money when the victim asked for repayment
Victim never got the funds back and was removed from the server

snippet: A person was persuaded by a Discord options host to send $2,700 in USDC on a promised return. When they asked for their money back the host demanded more and removed them from the server.

events.detail: Membership club offered introductions to women for a fee
Match sent only library photos and never a live selfie
Repeated new fees and deposits were required before any date
Target asked for a live selfie and challenged the match's reality
Target blocked the match and never sent money

snippet: A man was pulled into a paid dating club that asked for repeated fees before a date. He refused to pay further, questioned the match's identity, and blocked her.

events.detail: Client commissioned an artwork and offered a check
Sent a check for twice the agreed commission amount
Artist realised she was expected to refund the excess payment

snippet: An artist received a commission check for twice the agreed amount and was asked to refund the difference. The artist deposited the check and refused to send the money back.

events.detail: Buyer asked seller to text their wife instead of the app
Conversation moved from the marketplace to text messages
Fake Zelle agent said the seller's account was a business account
Seller shared screen on a FaceTime call and was asked to send $499
Seller felt uneasy and asked for a supervisor
Seller refused to complete the transaction and stopped

snippet: A seller of leather seats was moved to text and then asked to share a screen and send $499 to unlock a payment. The seller refused, and the bank stopped the transaction.

events.detail: Woman at a gas station asked for help paying for fuel
Driver later realised the request was a scam
Driver refused to pay and did not hand over money

snippet: A driver at a gas station was asked for help paying for fuel in exchange for foreign currency. The driver refused and did not give any money.

events.detail: Two men in a pickup told the driver her license plate had fallen off
Driver recognised her plate number and sensed danger
Driver kept driving and did not pull over

snippet: A driver was approached by men in a pickup who claimed her license plate had fallen off and held up a different plate. She recognised the plate was not hers, kept driving, and called for help.

events.detail: Buyer replied to a camera listing with an overseas deployment story
Buyer claimed military service and offered PayPal payment
Seller said the camera was sold and sent no details

snippet: A seller received an inquiry from a buyer claiming to be a deployed soldier who wanted a gift shipped. The seller did not send any payment details or the item.

events.detail: Free business presentation with big-name speakers pitched a course
Victim bought a $6,000 real estate course at the presentation
Victim returned the course and lost only the shipping cost

snippet: A person attended a free business presentation and bought a $6,000 real estate course. They returned it and lost only the cost of shipping it back.

events.detail: Unknown company repeatedly called claiming an unpaid balance
Company mailed a semi-legitimate looking bill for non-payment
Police and post office found no trace of the company
Recipient could not verify the company or the debt

snippet: A person received repeated calls and a fake-looking bill from a company they had never heard of, claiming an unpaid balance. Police and the post office could not trace the company, and the person paid nothing.

events.detail: Photo company sends a packet home and demands payment
Teacher blocks a field trip unless payment is brought in
Parent cites a state statute saying payment demands are illegal

snippet: A parent says a school photo company sends pictures home and demands payment, and a teacher has threatened a child with missing a field trip. The parent refuses to pay and cites a state statute.

events.detail: Man offered to donate a classic car to a charity for a raffle
Pushed the charity to start raffle and hand over a check quickly
Volunteer found the car title showed a 1980 reproduction
Board agreed the deal was a bad idea and declined

snippet: A man offered a charity a car to raffle off in exchange for a $30,000 advance check. A volunteer uncovered the car's age and the man's record, and the board declined.

events.detail: Moving company quoted $3,200 and then subcontracted the haul
Driver demanded $6,800 before delivering the household goods
Driver insisted on payment in cash or money order
Customers contacted the company over 50 times with no real answers

snippet: A family hired a moving company that subcontracted the job, and the driver demanded $6,800 in cash before delivering their furniture. The family could not get straight answers from the company.

events.detail: Near-daily texts from UK numbers reading only 2018
Recipient never replied and cannot block the changing numbers

snippet: A person in Ireland receives near-daily texts from changing UK numbers that only say 2018. The recipient has never replied and has lost nothing.

events.detail: Celebrities promoted crypto offerings without disclosing paid endorsements
Securities regulator charged the promoters with fraud

snippet: Two celebrities promoted cryptocurrency coin offerings without disclosing they had been paid. A securities regulator charged them with fraud.

events.detail: Phone call claimed Visa or MasterCard offered 0% interest
Caller claimed a business relationship between card networks and banks
Listener asked for their name and the caller swore
Listener ended the call and shared no information

snippet: A person received a call claiming their card company was offering 0% interest. When they asked the caller for their name, the caller cursed and hung up.

events.detail: Voicemail with a Texas area code claimed to be from the IRS
Caller claimed an arrest warrant for fraudulent tax filing
Caller repeatedly demanded the Social Security number and name
Recipient called back on a blocked line and recognised the script

snippet: A person received a voicemail from someone claiming to be the IRS and threatening an arrest warrant. The person called back, recognised the script, and did not share any details.

events.detail: Caller posed as a mail prescription service
Caller asked to verify the card used for prescription deliveries
Recipient stalled the caller with false details and hung up

snippet: A caller posing as a prescription mail service asked for a credit card number. The recipient stalled with invented prescriptions and ended the call without giving any details.

events.detail: Caller phoned about the recipient's computer
Second caller claimed to be from Microsoft technical department
Recipient mocked the call and recognised the search-result trick

snippet: A caller claimed to be from Microsoft about an infected computer and read out a serial number. The recipient exposed the trick by pointing out it was an easy web search result.

events.detail: Shop ran ads encouraging bulk purchases of discounted items
About-us photo of the owner was taken from another person's site

snippet: A shop posing as a small handmade craft business sold dropshipped goods. Its owner photo was taken from another person's website.

events.detail: Late-night caller claimed to be from a bank about a transfer
Caller asked for social security number and account details to verify
Spouse called official bank lines to check the calls
Bank helplines said the calls were genuine, but branch manager disagreed

snippet: A spouse received calls claiming to be from a bank asking for personal and account details. Bank helplines said the calls were genuine, but a branch manager later called the requests extremely sketchy.

events.detail: Promoter event pitched a crypto investment to an audience of novices
BBC investigated and Rwanda issued warnings against the scheme

snippet: A photographer observed a promotion event pitching a crypto investment to an audience with little financial knowledge. The scheme has since been investigated by the BBC and warned against by Rwanda.

events.detail: Recruiter contacted applicant over messaging after a job application
Claimed to be a staffing firm offering a remote job
Sent a check from an unrelated company for equipment purchase
Trainer pressed the applicant to deposit the check immediately
Applicant called the named company and confirmed the check was fake
Police and the FBI were contacted about the fraud

snippet: An applicant received a remote job offer and a check for equipment from a fake recruiter. The applicant verified with the named company, did not deposit the check, and reported the fraud.

events.detail: Puppy seller replied to dog ads with a sad backstory
Conversation moved from the website to email
Victim gave name, address and phone number to the seller
Victim searched online and found similar scams

snippet: A buyer responded to puppy ads and shared personal details with a seller who asked for an address and phone number. The buyer sent no money and became suspicious after searching online.

events.detail: Payer sent $150 via PayPal then said it was a mistake
Repeated money requests demanded a refund to the payer
Recipient suspected a hacked account and bounced payment
PayPal refused to reverse the transaction

snippet: A content creator received a $150 PayPal payment and was then repeatedly asked to send it back as a mistake. PayPal refused to reverse the payment, and the recipient feared a bounced transfer.

events.detail: Automated voicemail about a federal criminal offense
Message claimed a grand jury issue and a federal agent
Message called itself a final attempt to resolve the issue
Recipient ignored the voicemail and did not call back

snippet: A person received an automated voicemail claiming a federal criminal matter and urging a call back. They did not return the call.

events.detail: Wrong number reached a line mimicking a card company greeting
Recording offered an optional too-good-to-be-true card offer
Caller realised the number was one digit off the real line

snippet: A caller dialled a number one digit off a card company and heard a recording pitching an offer. The caller hung up, having given no information.

events.detail: Fake realty company emailed claiming to have taken over management
Email attached welcome letters to make the takeover look legitimate
Tenant texted the real landlord, who confirmed it was a scam
Landlord confirmed management was not changing and no portal was needed

snippet: A tenant received an email from a fake realty company claiming their building was under new management and asking them to log in to a new portal. The tenant checked with the landlord, who confirmed it was a scam, and nothing was lost.

events.detail: Buyer texted a seller asking to verify with a code
Seller recognised the verification code request as a scam pattern
Seller refused to call or share a verification code

snippet: A seller was contacted by a buyer who wanted a phone verification code to set up accounts. The seller recognised the scam pattern and refused to share the code.

events.detail: Text from a fake phone provider claimed a problem with the bill
Lookalike provider site asked for login and then debit card details
Partner entered email and password on the lookalike site
Partner checked the real account on a PC and stopped

snippet: A person received a text claiming a phone bill problem and entered login details on a lookalike provider site. They stopped before entering card details after checking the real account and found all bills paid.

events.detail: Post questions whether scammers use bad spelling to filter victims

snippet: A poster questions the common claim that scammers write poorly on purpose to filter out savvy targets. The post describes no specific scam event.

events.detail: Craigslist roommate ad drew a call and an in-person visit
Handed over keys and showed the room to seem like a real landlord
Victim paid $800 by money order for rent and deposit
Actual occupant revealed the house was used as an Airbnb
Victim lost the $800 and police called it a civil matter

snippet: A person paid $800 by money order for a room after being shown a house and given keys. The renter learned it was not the scammer's property and police treated the matter as civil.

events.detail: Noticed alerts for large packages never ordered
Found fraudulent card and address on credit report
Retailer and bank confirmed fraud and opened investigation

snippet: A person received many unordered packages after a fraudster opened a credit card in their name. They reported the fraud to the retailer and bank and froze their credit.

events.detail: Driver asked rider to cancel the order so he could collect a fee
Rider refused to cancel and asked driver to do it

snippet: A ride-hailing driver asked a passenger to cancel an order, which could have triggered a cancellation fee. The passenger refused and the scheme did not work.

events.detail: Stranger at work exchanged numbers and started a conversation
Met for coffee and pitched an introduction to a wealthy mentor
Proposed a multi-week vetting process and a five year investing plan
Victim unsure whether the pitch was legitimate and asked for advice

snippet: A person was approached by a stranger who built rapport and then pitched an investing opportunity through a mentor. The target was unsure whether it was a scam and asked for advice.

events.detail: Facebook ad advertised very cheap dumbbells from an online retailer
Site looked legitimate with many positive comments
Paid 89 dollars by credit card for dumbbells
Researched afterward and found the site was a known scam

snippet: A person bought dumbbells from a fake online retailer advertised on Facebook, paying 89 dollars by credit card. They later confirmed the site was fraudulent and sought a chargeback.

events.detail: Phone call claimed the victim owed money for an ambulance bill
Caller posed as a debt collector and cited accurate personal details
Pressed for immediate settlement and refused to send written terms
Checked insurance statement and confirmed nothing was owed
Hung up after realising the call was a scam

snippet: A person received a call from someone posing as a debt collector who knew details of their recent surgery. They checked their insurance statement, confirmed nothing was owed, and hung up.

events.detail: Card charged 3 dollars roughly twice a month for months
Found vague direct marketing charges and a suspicious website

snippet: A person was repeatedly charged small amounts by an unknown direct marketing company for about three months. They spotted the charges on their transaction history and replaced their card.

events.detail: Fake celebrity charity Facebook page drew in an elderly woman
Chatted for months posing as a celebrity and sent flowers
Repeatedly donated to a fake charity
Family contacted authorities and tried to get the page removed
Refused to believe it was a scam despite family evidence

snippet: An elderly woman was romantically targeted by someone posing as a celebrity through a fake charity page, and she made repeated donations. Her family contacted authorities and tried to take the page down without success.

events.detail: Stranger on a chat site asked for social media account
Asked to move to a video call on another app
Tested the caller with a hand sign and noticed the video was fake
Blocked the stranger on both platforms and deactivated account

snippet: A young man was targeted by a blackmail attempt after a stranger from a chat site asked him to switch to a video call. He tested the caller, noticed the video was fake, and blocked the stranger.

events.detail: Call showed a local police department name on caller ID
Did not answer unfamiliar number and no voicemail was left

snippet: A person received a call with a disguised caller ID showing a city police department from another state. They did not answer and the caller left no voicemail.

events.detail: PayPal sided with former employer on two refund disputes
Former boss issued another refund for May 2020 work
Lost two months of salary to refunds for delivered work

snippet: A freelance video editor says a former employer used PayPal buyer refunds to take back payment for completed work. The editor says PayPal sided with the employer in two disputes.

events.detail: Hacked friend sent link asking to vote for a CS:GO team
Poster warned others not to enter login details on the site

snippet: A user warns Steam account holders about a phishing link sent from a hacked friend account. The link asked for login details on a fake login page.

events.detail: Discord message offered random users free bitcoin
Site showed a bitcoin balance after redeeming a code
Withdrawal required a 0.03 BTC deposit to stop bots
Poster refused the deposit and warned others away

snippet: A user was offered free bitcoin through a Discord message and found the withdrawal required a deposit. They refused to pay and warned others about the site.

events.detail: Stranger on an app asked for explicit photos
Asked to move to Instagram and then sent threats
Threatened to send photos to followers unless paid
Agreed to send 250 dollars through a money transfer service
Cancelled the transfer and blocked the scammer

snippet: A man sent explicit photos to a stranger who then threatened to share them unless he paid. He cancelled the payment before it was collected and blocked the scammers.

events.detail: Matched with a profile on a dating app
Chatted and later revealed she was a cam performer
Asked for video chat after she pushed a sketchy website
Ghosted the match after she became defensive

snippet: A man matched with a profile on a dating app and was pushed to sign up for a sketchy website. He asked for a video chat instead, then stopped responding.

events.detail: Girl messaged and obtained explicit photos from a minor
Threatened to send photos to parents and friends on Instagram
Parents, a lawyer and police became involved
Deleted social media and blocked the scammer on all platforms

snippet: A teenager was sextorted after sending photos to someone online who threatened to share them. Family, a lawyer and police became involved, and the photos were reportedly not shared.

events.detail: Throwaway account messaged offering a brand ambassador role
Recognised the pattern as a known brand ambassador scam

snippet: A person received a brand ambassador offer from a spam account and recognised it as a scam. They played along to test it and paid nothing.

events.detail: Man met online claimed to teach access to hidden trust funds
Visited the family home and talked with parents for hours
Poster doubts the trust fund claim but mother believes it

snippet: A person's mother became convinced that an online contact could unlock a secret trust fund tied to a social security number. The poster doubts the claim and asks for information.

events.detail: Gmail flooded with hundreds of subscription confirmation emails
Suspects compromised account and temporarily blocked bank cards

snippet: A person's email account was flooded with subscription confirmations, which they suspect is meant to hide a warning or purchase email from an attacker. They temporarily blocked their bank cards.

events.detail: Fake Messenger account impersonated a relative and texted the victim
Directed victim to an attorney to apply for a government grant
Texts grew more aggressive when victim delayed
Refused the grant process and considered contacting law enforcement

snippet: Someone impersonated a relative on social media and contacted family members, pushing a fake government grant through an attorney. The target refused and considered contacting law enforcement.

events.detail: Dating app match moved the conversation to Instagram
Moved to a video call and recorded the victim
Threatened to share video and messaged the victim's sister
Paid 280 euros by PayPal under pressure
Demanded a further 200 euros later
Realised ignoring the demands would have been the better choice

snippet: A man was lured from a dating app to a video call that was recorded and used to threaten him. He paid 280 euros by PayPal and was told to pay more.

events.detail: Stranger messaged offering money after a donation post
Asked for a phone account login to receive money
Refused to share the login and the stranger vanished

snippet: A person who was struggling financially was contacted by a stranger offering money after a donation post. When they refused to share a phone account login, the stranger disappeared.

events.detail: Poster set up a fake audiobook listing with imported book data
Marketplace removed the listing for copyright infringement

snippet: A researcher posted a fake audiobook listing on a creator marketplace to test whether it screens rights holders. Two auditions were submitted before the platform took the listing down, and no money changed hands.

events.detail: Domain registrars and hosts can take down scam sites

snippet: A user shares a guide for reporting scam websites to their domain registrar and hosting provider. No victim loss is described.

events.detail: Met a man on a dating app who pursued her quickly
Moved conversation to WhatsApp and daily phone calls
Built a romantic relationship with daily messages and sweet talk
Moved 600 dollars into crypto and onto a trading app
Trading app showed balances growing to millions
Added larger sums under pressure to fund trading plans
Account frozen and a penalty demanded before withdrawal
Realised the money sent could not be recovered

snippet: A woman was drawn into a romantic crypto trading scam through a dating app and lost the money she sent. The fake trading app then froze her account and demanded a penalty.

events.detail: Chatted with a profile on a dating app after sharing photos
Asked for phone number and sent a blackmail text
Demanded a 500 dollar gift card within 25 minutes
Repeated the message back and friends called the blocked number

snippet: A man was blackmailed after a dating app chat, with a demand for a gift card within minutes. He refused to pay and his friends called the scammer back.

events.detail: Fake CEO email asked an employee for his phone number
Contacted the employee on WhatsApp and asked for gift cards
Employee bought large amount of gift cards for scammer
Employee realised it was a scam after repeated demands
IT worker called other staff and stopped another purchase

snippet: A new employee was tricked by a fake CEO email into buying gift cards for a large amount. An IT worker found other targets and stopped a second employee from buying cards.

events.detail: Noticed flood of newsletter signup emails and suspected fraud
Bank found deposits and closed the compromised account

snippet: A person's sibling was hit with a flood of subscription emails used to hide a fraudulent transfer from her savings account. The bank closed the account and opened a new one.

events.detail: Met a man through a food-related Instagram account
Moved conversation to WhatsApp and a trading app
Built a romantic relationship and a wealthy backstory
Trading app shown to encourage investment
Researched the scam and recognised the pattern
Ended the relationship and did not send further money

snippet: A person was targeted in a romance-based crypto investment scam through social media and messaging apps. They ended the relationship and did not lose money.

events.detail: Message from a coworker's hacked account asked for a code
Shared a two-factor verification code with the scammer
Over 1000 dollars sent out via payment app to friends
Bank and card issuer cancelled the card and secured the account

snippet: A person shared a two-factor code after a message from a friend's hacked account. The scammer took over the account and drained over 1000 dollars through the payment app before the card was cancelled.

events.detail: Text asked the victim to call about a drug test result
Caller claimed to be a medical review officer
Claimed a positive drug test and threatened the new job
Partner checked the number and found reports of similar scams

snippet: A man was called about a failed pre-employment drug test and asked to verify his identity details. His partner found reports of the same number targeting others, and he froze his credit.

events.detail: Friend of a relative was given a 27k check to deposit
Poster declined to deposit the check and suspected a scam

snippet: A relative was asked to deposit a large out-of-state check and pass cash back to a friend. The poster declined, correctly suspecting the arrangement was a scam.

events.detail: Email threatened to use photos against the recipient
Did not enter login details on the suspicious share link

snippet: A person received an anonymous email threatening to use photos against them, with a link that asked for login details. They did not enter their information.

events.detail: Messenger notified of a 700 dollar PayPal payment from a friend
Pending payment request with a pay button shown
Messages and calls demanded the money be returned
Called mutual friend who confirmed the account had been hacked

snippet: A person received a fake PayPal payment notice from a friend's hacked Messenger account and was pressured to return money. They confirmed with a mutual friend that the account was compromised and did not pay.

events.detail: Checked the gift card and found a zero balance
Found two 100 dollar cards bought online elsewhere
Police said nothing could be done to recover the money

snippet: A person was paid 200 dollars for an Xbox in a prepaid gift card that was later drained. Two gift cards were bought online and shipped to another city, and police did not pursue it.

events.detail: Text claimed the victim faced charges over a website contact
Caller posed as parent and then as an investigator
Demanded payments to avoid charges and rehab costs
Second caller prompted questions about whether to block number

snippet: A former soldier was extorted with threats of criminal charges after a website contact, first by someone claiming to be a parent and then by a caller posing as an investigator. He questioned whether to pay or block the number.

events.detail: Text offered a job interview conducted over a messaging app
Company claimed to hire for software roles and mail equipment
Requested a 250 dollar payment for equipment before offer
Called the company and found mismatched details
Deleted messages and blocked the recruiter

snippet: A job applicant was pushed to pay 250 dollars for equipment before receiving an offer. The applicant refused, found the company details did not match, and blocked the recruiter.

events.detail: Paid for a dating subscription and cancelled within the hour
Company refused cancellation and demanded a driver's license
Card issuer finalised chargeback in the victim's favour

snippet: A person signed up for a dating subscription and cancelled within an hour, but the company refused to refund. The card issuer reversed the charge after the person provided evidence.

events.detail: Caller posed as a police officer about an underage girl
Same caller later posed as the girl's father on a call
Demanded 1500 dollars for damages to avoid charges
Family realised the calls were fake and reported the payment app

snippet: A family was extorted by a caller who posed as a police officer and then as an angry father, demanding payment for damages. The family did not pay and reported the payment app account.

events.detail: Texted for weeks before asking to use the victim's number
Asked whether the verification code request was a scam

snippet: A person was texted by a contact who asked to use their phone number to receive a payment app verification code. The person was unsure whether it was a scam.

events.detail: Dating app match asked to meet at a hotel
Asked for a passport photo before the meeting
Offered a background check instead and sensed a bad feeling
Ended interest in the match

snippet: A man was asked to send a passport photo by a dating app match who wanted to meet at a hotel. He offered a background check instead, and then ended contact.

events.detail: Spam number called and texted insults and a false health claim
Texted a date falsely claiming an STD and insulting her
Wondered whether his phone had been accessed by hackers

snippet: A man received harassing calls and texts from an unknown number, which also contacted his date with false claims. He was worried the harasser had access to his phone.

events.detail: Instagram account messaged claiming evidence of a fake ID purchase
Posted an alleged date of birth and sent personal details
Changed logins and logged out all devices after the messages

snippet: A woman was blackmailed through Instagram by an account claiming to have evidence of a fake ID purchase. The couple changed passwords and logged out devices after personal details were shared.

events.detail: Stranger asked the poster to hold a few hundred dollars cash
Declined the request, suspecting a scam

snippet: A stranger asked a person to hold a few hundred dollars in cash while he went elsewhere. The person declined, suspecting a scam.

events.detail: Noticed a 30 dollar gas station charge on a card still in hand
Closed the card after the unexplained charge

snippet: A friend's card number was used for a small gas station purchase days after they swiped it at a store. The friend closed the card and the cause is unclear.

events.detail: Film project on Instagram and IMDb offered huge salaries
Poster found inconsistent backgrounds and no real online presence

snippet: A film project advertised large salaries to actors and crew for work abroad. A researcher found inconsistent backstories and little real online presence, and is investigating further.

events.detail: Marketplace buyer insisted on paying by Zelle for a couch
Buyer sent payment screenshot and a fake Zelle limited notice
Buyer demanded a 300 dollar payment to release funds
Seller found the notice suspicious and did not send refund

snippet: A seller was targeted by a buyer who sent a fake payment screenshot and a notice saying the account was limited. The seller did not pay the requested fee and the buyer demanded a refund.

events.detail: Found device in a box with a phone number on it
Hung up after the caller pitched a heart monitoring sign-up

snippet: A person found an unlabelled device box with a phone number and called it to return the device. The caller pitched a heart monitor sign-up and collected details, and the person hung up.

events.detail: Caller posed as Amazon security and showed an account access photo
Mother installed remote viewing software on desktop and phone
Relative told parents to power off devices and change passwords

snippet: An elderly couple was contacted by someone posing as Amazon security after a technician visit, and granted remote access to their devices. A relative advised them to power off devices and change their banking passwords.

events.detail: Paid 1200 dollars in full before the wedding
Photographer double-booked, delayed photos and stopped replying
Found photographer had moved, changed name and left business

snippet: A couple paid their wedding photographer in full, but she double-booked the day, then went silent and never delivered the photos. They discovered she had moved away and changed her name.

events.detail: Fake account copied grandmother's photos and followed her friends
Family reported the account and warned grandmother's friends

snippet: Someone created a fake Instagram account impersonating an elderly woman and followed her friends. Her family reported the account and warned her contacts.

events.detail: Poster flagged dubious accreditation and marketing-focused coaching academy

snippet: A person is considering paying 5000 dollars for a life coaching course. A third party noticed dubious accreditation claims and a sales-heavy focus on recruiting coaches.

events.detail: Caller ordered a pizza to an elderly man's house without payment
Pushed for the driver to hand over the pizza and take payment later
Driver refused the handover and warned the homeowner

snippet: A delivery driver was asked to hand a pizza to an elderly man whose order was placed by a caller who would not pay. The driver refused and warned the homeowner.

events.detail: Family received a call about a subpoena and a lawsuit
Paralegal claimed a lawsuit and threatened arrest if served
Victim confirmed their social security number on the call
Police said the call sounded like an elaborate scam
Froze credit and alerted bank after realising it was a scam

snippet: A person was contacted by a fake law firm claiming they faced a lawsuit and arrest. They confirmed their social security number before police and the person froze their credit.

events.detail: Seller replied to listing claiming the car was in Denmark
Shared a personal story and a plausible regulation change
Asked for a video call and title photo to verify the car
Seller went silent after the buyer proposed escrow terms

snippet: A buyer was offered a discounted classic car from abroad and pushed toward shipping payments through a third party. The buyer proposed escrow and video verification, and the seller stopped replying.

events.detail: Built a romance over phone and text with a guy abroad
Forwarded a wired transfer to a recipient as instructed
Bank froze accounts and contacted its fraud department
Caught lies and refused to convert money to bitcoin
Recipient took the remaining funds after accounts were frozen

snippet: A person was romantically targeted and sent on wired funds that turned out to be part of a scheme. The bank froze the accounts and the remaining funds were taken by the recipient.

events.detail: Woman sent unsolicited message on WhatsApp to a man
Fostered a romantic relationship over about five months
Directed him to move money from an exchange to a fake crypto site
Fake crypto site showed a growing balance
Moved about 250000 dollars to the scammer over months
Claimed a hospitalisation and demanded 400000 dollars
Bank flagged and blocked a large wire attempt

snippet: A man was romantically groomed over several months and moved about 250000 dollars through a fake crypto site. His family discovered the scam after his death, and a further 400000 dollar demand was blocked by his bank.

events.detail: Older customer repeatedly buys maximum amount of Steam cards
Shop staff suspect scam but can only refuse service

snippet: A video game store employee noticed older customers repeatedly buying the maximum number of Steam gift cards, with one spending over 10000 AUD. Staff suspect a scam but can only refuse service.

events.detail: Buyer replied almost immediately to a marketplace listing
Received a verification code that warned not to share it

snippet: A seller on a marketplace app was contacted by a buyer who asked for their phone number and then triggered a verification code. The seller did not lose money.

events.detail: Matched on a dating app with a woman claiming to be a CFO
Switched to WhatsApp and then phone calls
Pushed for closeness quickly and revealed very little about herself
Pressed for 100000 dollars to be invested in Ethereum
Researched the app and found similar frauds, then refused
Stopped engaging before sending the bulk of the funds

snippet: A man was targeted by a dating-app woman who moved him to crypto investing with a fake DeFi app. He researched the scheme, refused to invest the large sum, and stopped contact.

events.detail: Fake applicants with fabricated resumes applied to tech roles
Recruiter noticed many fake resumes and LinkedIn profiles

snippet: A talent acquisition specialist noticed a surge of fake applicants with fabricated resumes and LinkedIn profiles. They are compiling red flags to avoid hiring a scammer.

events.detail: Forged driver's licenses used to list vacant land for sale
Buyer wired cash for a lot the seller did not own
County deed alert revealed the land had been sold fraudulently
Parents spent almost 40000 dollars on legal fees to recover land

snippet: A property fraudster used forged licences to sell vacant land that did not belong to them. The true owners discovered the sale through a county alert and spent almost 40000 dollars recovering it.

events.detail: Recruiter emailed after an online job application
Moved interview to an encrypted text messaging app
Declared applicant a great fit after brief texted questions
Asked for a call and found employer details did not match

snippet: A job seeker was interviewed by text and asked to provide bank and social security details for direct deposit. They called the company, found none of the details matched, and did not lose money.

events.detail: Private number calls about a supposed warrant for missed appearance
Caller passed between people claiming to be special agents
Caller pressured victim over the supposed failure to appear
Victim doubted the warrant after noticing the PDF looked edited

snippet: A person received a call claiming a warrant existed for a missed court appearance, followed by a reimbursement PDF. They doubted the call and the caller ended it.

events.detail: Fake rental listing for a vacant house posted on Facebook
Prospective renters paid application fees and deposits to scammer
Neighbour warned renters and reported the scam to the listing company

snippet: A vacant house was advertised for rent on Facebook using photos taken from a listing site. Some would-be renters paid fees and deposits before a neighbour warned others.

events.detail: Automated call asked user to press 1 about an Apple ID change
Live caller posed as Apple technical support about an open ticket
User said no change was requested and hung up
Apple confirmed it had not made any such request

snippet: A user received automated and live calls impersonating Apple support about changing the phone number on an Apple ID. The user hung up, blocked the numbers and Apple confirmed the calls were fake.

events.detail: Cloned clothing retailer site for Mexico required a login
Victim paid about $100 by credit card for an order
Sent text-only confirmations and a delayed, fake shipment
Victim contacted customer service and the credit card company

snippet: A victim paid about $100 on a cloned clothing retailer site for Mexico. The order arrived as counterfeit sunglasses after weeks of delays and the card dispute looks unlikely to succeed.

events.detail: Told victim to pay a fee before the loan would be released
Victim borrowed money and paid the fee to the scammer
Victim realised the money was gone and feels ruined

snippet: A financially struggling person borrowed money to pay a loan fee demanded by a scammer. The loss has left the victim distressed and without hope.

events.detail: Offered an obscure car part in a Facebook owners group comment
Victim paid the seller by bank transfer after agreeing a price
Sent a tracking email linking to a fake shipping website
Demanded £100 duty-free insurance fee before shipping
Victim recognised the scam and blocked the seller

snippet: A buyer paid for a car part sold in a Facebook group and received a fake tracking link. When the seller demanded a £100 insurance fee, the buyer recognised the scam and blocked the seller.

events.detail: Loan sign-up flagged SSN as already used by another account

snippet: A person trying to sign up for a loan app was told their SSN was already linked to another account. They reported no fraud on existing accounts and asked for advice.

events.detail: Company advertised custom pet embroidery hoodies on Instagram
Website reviews appear fake and stolen
Poster warns others not to buy from the company

snippet: A buyer received a poor custom pet embroidery order from a company advertised on Instagram. The buyer believes the company's reviews are fake and warns others to avoid it.

events.detail: Phishing email imitated a Fidelity secure tax message
Entered username and password on a fake login page
Realised the page was fake and called Fidelity
Fidelity support helped reset credentials and enable two-factor authentication

snippet: A user entered login details on a fake Fidelity page after a phishing email. Fidelity helped reset the credentials and turn on two-factor authentication, and no money loss is reported.

events.detail: Two men visited home claiming to be from new energy supplier
Claimed to be checking the bill and the supplier switch
Victim looked up the company and found reports of false sign-ups

snippet: Two men at the victim's home falsely claimed to represent the energy supplier and got them to sign a switch. The victim later found reports of similar false sign-ups and caught it early.

events.detail: Voicemail from unknown number posing as a retiring doctor
Searched the number and found no matching practice
Did not leave a message and stopped engaging

snippet: An office manager received a voicemail from a number pretending to be a retiring doctor seeking referrals. They checked the number, found no matching practice, and did not engage.

events.detail: Online boyfriend of an elderly colleague claimed to run an oil rig
Fake Amazon invoice shown with unofficial email addresses
Colleague says she already paid for two earlier orders
Coworker raised the alarm and a police officer took a report

snippet: An elderly colleague was asked to pay a $46,000 Amazon water order for an online partner. A coworker spotted the fake invoice and police were brought in to take a report.

events.detail: Weeks of online romance followed by a request for visa money

snippet: A travel agent warns that a romantic partner from Russia asking for about $700 for a visa is a scam. The post advises asking for her passport details to test the request.

events.detail: Buyer offered to purchase an item for $500
Sent counterfeit mobile checks worth $6,000 for a $500 sale
Victim sent $4,000 in change to the buyer
Victim became suspicious and refused to send more money
Buyer threatened legal action and called victim a thief

snippet: A seller was sent counterfeit checks for $6,000 on a $500 sale and returned $4,000 in change. The buyer then threatened legal action and kept calling and texting.

events.detail: Verizon business rep promised to cancel unused lines and devices
Customer found lines still billed long after cancellation

snippet: A customer was billed for lines and devices they believed a Verizon business rep had cancelled. The customer says the company has not corrected the charges despite repeated contact.

events.detail: Sugar dating site contact arranged to send a check
Sent a fraudulent $1,500 check for the teen to deposit
Refused to send money back to the scammer
Bank removed the funds and placed a hold on the account

snippet: A teenager deposited a fraudulent $1,500 check from a dating site contact but did not send money back. Her bank removed the funds and put a hold on the account until the check was resolved.

events.detail: Online relationship between the husband and a woman in her forties
Husband sent about $3,000 in Bitcoin to his online partner
Family plans to confront him and protect his wife's finances

snippet: An elderly man sent about $3,000 in Bitcoin to a woman he met online and refuses to stop. His family is planning to confront him and protect his wife's finances.

events.detail: Caller phoned father claiming son was harassing his sister
Caller made a veiled threat against the son during the call

snippet: A caller phoned a young man's parents claiming he was texting an underage girl, which he denies. He asks whether he should act on the call or ignore it.

events.detail: Remote part-time job email exchange with a fake company
Sent driver's license photo to a fake HR contact
Recognised the scam before sharing bank or SSN details
Plans to report the scammers and cut contact

snippet: A job seeker sent a driver's license photo to a fake HR contact before recognising a fake job scam. They did not share bank or SSN details and plan to report the company.

events.detail: Messages to husband claimed iCloud photos were being shared
Owner recognised the messages as scam but wonders how they got her name

snippet: After her phone was stolen, a woman's husband received scam messages using her full name claiming iCloud photos were being shared. She recognised the messages as a scam but wondered how the scammers knew her name.

events.detail: Caller confirmed husband's identity and recited his SSN and address
Transferred to someone posing as Wells Fargo collections
Demanded $800 and threatened account freeze for five years
Husband refused to pay and ended the call

snippet: A husband received a call claiming he was being sued over an old Wells Fargo account and was asked for $800. He refused to pay, though the caller already knew his SSN and address.

events.detail: Craigslist car buyer mailed a cashier's check for the purchase
Check showed as cleared after several days of pending status
Bank reversed the deposit five days later as fraudulent

snippet: A parent sold a car after a mailed cashier's check appeared cleared in their account. Five days later the bank took the money back as fraudulent.

events.detail: Asks why people still fall for obvious scams

snippet: A poster asks why people keep falling for obvious scams such as meme coins and fake trading platforms. The post contains no victim story.

events.detail: Calls from a number matching a police precinct accused caller of crime
Caller claimed to be police and demanded a $1,800 test payment
Poster suspects a scam and asks whether to worry

snippet: A person received calls claiming to be from a police precinct and demanded a $1,800 test payment. They suspected a scam and asked whether they should worry about the personal details the caller had.

events.detail: Fraudulent email from work account asked payroll to change bank details
Paycheck was diverted to an account the worker does not control
Payroll coordinator asked about the email and flagged it

snippet: A worker's direct deposit was changed through a fraudulent email sent from their work account. Payroll is now working to recover the diverted paycheck.

events.detail: Caller's number matched a police department on maps
Claimed to be a police officer and demanded a $2,200 evaluation
Threatened an arrest warrant if the victim hung up
Checked the sergeant's number and found no information
Pleaded the Fifth and hung up

snippet: A caller claimed to be a police officer and demanded a $2,200 psychological evaluation under threat of arrest. The victim checked the sergeant's number, found nothing, and hung up.

events.detail: Noticed the same double-parked car and cement mixer repeatedly

snippet: A visitor to New York noticed the same car double-parked with a mixer truck honking, and two men checking the street. They found a similar Reddit post and asked what the scam is.

events.detail: Stepfather buys gift cards daily and sends the codes to a scammer
Stepchildren are seeking legal options to stop the payments

snippet: A stepfather has been buying gift cards daily and sending the codes to a scammer after selling the family house. His stepchildren are seeking legal options to step in.

events.detail: Private caller got home address for a fake high school reunion
Victim traced the calls to an unrelated private investigation firm

snippet: After giving an address to a caller about a fake high school reunion, pizzas were ordered in the victim's name. The victim traced the calls to an unrelated firm and wants to find who is behind them.

events.detail: Online girlfriend the father has never met
Claimed she needed $80,000 to settle her late father's estate
Father reportedly sent $90,000, though it is unclear if joking
Relatives plan to intervene and secure his finances

snippet: A man's relatives believe his online girlfriend is scamming him after he reportedly sent $90,000 and plans to travel abroad. They are trying to convince him to stop and secure his finances.

events.detail: Caller claimed to be the Fire Dept inspecting extinguishers and smoke detectors
Caller later claimed to be a Regional Vice President
Employee questioned the contradictions in the caller's story
Employee hung up on the caller

snippet: An employee received a call from someone claiming to be from the fire department, then a regional vice president, asking for information. The employee noticed the contradictions and hung up.

events.detail: Call displayed as Google claimed the account was under attack
Caller posed as security helping to protect crypto assets
Told friend to transfer funds quickly to a third-party app
Friend sent $8,000 in crypto through the app
Poster told friend to hang up but it was too late
Friend realised the $8,000 was gone

snippet: A friend received a call from a number showing as Google and transferred $8,000 in crypto to a third-party app. A witness tried to stop it, but the money was already gone.

events.detail: Caller claimed to be medical billing about an outstanding bill
Asked victim to authenticate with SSN last four and address
Asked for caller's name, employee ID and company details
Hung up after refusing to authenticate

snippet: A person received calls from someone claiming to be a medical billing agent who asked for identity details. The person refused, asked questions, and hung up, and later reported a second call from the same caller.

events.detail: Caller claimed to be a county sheriff with charges pending
Asked for a callback number and none was given
